Strawberry Muffins
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 9:58pm

Ingredients




cup Strawberries Chopped
3 tablespoons Sugar
teaspoon Cinnamon

Preparation

1 2 Cup Flour1 Tbsp Baking Powder1/2 Tsp Salt 2 1 Egg - Beaten1/2 cup Milk1/2 cup Sour Cream1/3 cup Butter - Melted1/2 cup Brown Sugar - Packed 3 Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Toss the strawberries with the sugar and cinnamon. Sift together the next 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients, just till moistened. Fold in the strawberries. Fill paper-lined or Pam sprayed muffin tins full, and bake approximately 20 minutes. 4 Makes 12 muffins.
